h: Zlatan Ibile shows off wedding gift from billionaire Tony Elumelu and his wife Davita
p: Singer Zlatan Ibile has shared the wedding present he reportedly received from banker Tony Elumelu and his wife Davita, and fans are reacting. The gift adds to the long list of talking points from his star-studded wedding.
more: Zlatan reportedly posted the gift for his followers to see.
Fans are praising the gesture in the comments.
